official_protocol: CUDA AMP fp16; sigmoid on the logits dtype; threshold 0.5; 14 labels including nitro
note: Training-only BN buffer recalibration; no gradient or optimizer updates

gate_policy.supersedes: raman-bn-gate-v4 (same tolerances and gates; the audit label KNOWN_FP16_MAP_DEVIATION_ONLY was renamed to the neutral MAP_ONLY_NUMERIC_MISMATCH because it named a cause the check cannot establish, and because that label alone could be approved at any magnitude; release now requires an explicit approval bound to the checkpoint sha256). raman-bn-gate-v3 (no manifest on numeric failure) and raman-bn-gate-v2 (mAP-only 3e-3 envelope, withdrawn before use) are superseded.
gate_policy.principle: Artifact integrity and numerical reproducibility are two independent verdicts. No per-model and no per-metric tolerance adjustment: every one of the six official metrics is held to 1e-3, exactly as in IR v1 / UVSPEC15 v1. The BN summary tolerance is also 1e-3. A numerical failure is recorded as a failure, is never re-rolled, and is never converted into a pass by a label or by a file existing.

measured.localisation: the mAP variation is carried almost entirely by nitro AP (n=11)

gate_policy.known_limitation: The Phase 2 record was produced with torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark=True and cudnn.deterministic unset, i.e. under a configuration whose convolution algorithm selection is not pinned. The recorded FP16 mAP is therefore one sample from a nondeterministic ensemble and cannot be bit-reproduced by any later run. This is a property of the reference, not of the saved artifact, and it is the actual source of the seed-42 failure. It is measured, not waived: see gate policy v4's manifest policy and training/verify_raman_bn_reproducibility.py.

numeric_reproduction.channel: official FP16 sigmoid at threshold 0.5 (historical protocol, unchanged)

statuses.PASS: all six official metrics within 1e-3 of the Phase 2 record
statuses.FAIL: at least one official metric deviates by more than 1e-3; recorded verbatim as a numerical reproduction failure

manifest_policy.ARTIFACT_PASS__NUMERIC_FAIL: manifest written for provenance and human review. Release is NOT_ELIGIBLE unless an explicit approval bound to this checkpoint's sha256 is supplied (--manual-approval-note + --approve-checkpoint-sha256), in which case the release becomes ELIGIBLE_WITH_MANUAL_APPROVAL. The numeric verdict stays FAIL in all cases.
manifest_policy.audit_label: MAP_ONLY_NUMERIC_MISMATCH is descriptive (which metrics moved), never causal, and by itself authorises nothing at any magnitude

numeric_reproduction.retry_policy: single shot; a verdict is never re-rolled. Re-running to obtain a different verdict is forbidden.

auxiliary_channel.name: FP32 sigmoid metrics plus a fixed-algorithm (deterministic) evaluation path: cudnn.benchmark=False, cudnn.deterministic=True, use_deterministic_algorithms(True), CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8
auxiliary_channel.note: No Phase 2 reference exists for this channel, so it cannot gate. It measures cross-process stability of the artifact and is never compared with, merged into, or substituted for the official FP16 numbers.

label_policy.nitro: reported per label, never used to redefine mAP
